summary: Request: one-click rollback for quantization profile experiments (restore prior known-good profile quickly)
description:
Customer request (Northbridge Analytics, Dedicated PoC)

Summary
- Customer is actively experimenting with quantization profiles (int8/fp8 variants) to reduce cost.
- They want a fast, low-risk rollback mechanism when a profile causes quality regressions or latency spikes.
- Current rollback requires manual edits + redeploy/pin changes, and they’re concerned about blast radius and time-to-mitigate.

What happened / context
- During a profiling session on llama-3.1-70b-instruct, the customer switched from a baseline profile to a more aggressive quant profile.
- They observed:
  - Quality regression (more refusal / factual drift) in a small prompt set.
  - Increased tail latency (p99) during peak concurrency (likely cache/batching interaction + kernel choice).
- They were able to mitigate by manually reverting to the previous profile, but it was slow and required Redwood assistance to confirm which profile was active.

Requested capability
- “One-click rollback” (Console) and/or a single API call to revert to prior known-good quantization profile.
- Requirements from customer:
  - Must be scoped (tenant + model + region).
  - Must be fast (minutes, not hours) and safe under partial rollout.
  - Must be auditable (who/when/what changed).
  - Must show the currently active profile/version in an obvious place.

Business impact
- Customer sees rollback speed as a blocker to broader experimentation and to enabling more aggressive cost-saving profiles in production.
- They flagged this as a procurement risk item for expanding beyond the current Dedicated PoC.

Interim workaround offered (current state)
- Pin a known-good quantization profile explicitly and keep a “baseline” profile ID documented.
- Make changes only via a canary scope (small % traffic / limited routes) and wait for quality checks before promoting.
- For urgent mitigation:
  - Revert quant profile to baseline via config update (Support-assisted if needed).
  - If any uncertainty about active settings: request runtime headers / debug metadata from Redwood to confirm applied profile.

Ask to Product/Engineering
- Track as a feature request under the ongoing Safe Apply + Rollback project for Optimization Configs (includes quantization profiles).
- Customer would like:
  - Console: a dedicated rollback button with blast-radius summary.
  - API: rollback endpoint with idempotency guarantees.
  - Audit log event: optimization_config.rollback (with config_version + previous_version + scope).

Notes
- Customer is comfortable with “human-confirmed rollback” (no fully automated rollback required).
- They prefer an approach that supports dedicated + private parity (they mentioned future Private deployment evaluation).

Next steps committed to customer
- Provide a short write-up of the recommended canary + pinning workflow for quant profiles.
- Share ETA once Product confirms rollout milestones for the safe apply/rollback feature set.
- Offer to schedule a 30-minute session with Applied ML (Arjun Desai / Jonas Weber) to align on quality gate metrics and thresholds.
comments: 2026-01-08 10:14 PT — Colin O'Donnell (Reporter): Logged per Northbridge request from PoC check-in. They want a single rollback action for quant profile experiments; current manual revert + confirmation is too slow. Asking for auditability + visible active version.

2026-01-08 12:02 PT — Support (via Colin): Sent interim guidance: keep baseline profile pinned; use narrow canary scope; document profile IDs; if urgent, revert profile immediately and we’ll help confirm active version using internal debug headers/logs.

2026-01-09 09:26 PT — Arjun Desai (Applied ML): Agree this is a recurring pain point. From quant side, rollback must revert the *exact* profile variant and kernel settings; partial apply can create mixed behavior across workers. Strongly recommend tying rollback to versioned Optimization Config + runtime idempotency work.

2026-01-10 14:40 PT — Paula Mendes (PM): Confirmed this maps to Safe Apply + Rollback initiative (Optimization Config versioning). We will include quant profile rollback with quality gates (eval harness) in limited GA, with audit log + RBAC. No commitment to fully automated rollback for external customers in v1.

2026-01-12 11:05 PT — Northbridge (Customer): Thanks. Main need is: (1) obvious “active quant profile/version” in Console, (2) rollback in <5 minutes with clear scope, (3) audit log coverage for change + rollback. They’re fine with human-confirmed rollback modal.

2026-01-17 16:18 PT — Colin O'Donnell: Marking resolved as “tracked on roadmap.” Shared interim workaround doc + offered session with Applied ML to set regression thresholds. Will re-open if customer hits repeated regressions before rollout.
resolution: Feature request acknowledged and tracked under Safe Apply + Rollback for Optimization Configs (includes quant profile versioning + rollback). Interim workaround provided (pin baseline profile, canary changes, Support-assisted revert + confirmation of active profile).
